chunks: 3202 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hisham, who said:

Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said: “If the distance becomes great for one of you and the abode is far from him, then let him ascend the highest part of his dwelling, perform two rak'ahs, and gesture with salām toward our graves, for indeed that reaches us.”

key_terms.قُبُورِنَا: our graves, referring to the graves of the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.ٱلدَّارُ: the dwelling or abode from which one is far
key_terms.ٱلسَّلَامِ: greeting of peace directed toward the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What should a believer do if distance prevents visiting the graves of the Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a substitute devotional act for one who is unable to travel from afar to visit the graves of the Imams عليهم السلام. It instructs the believer to perform two rak'ahs and direct salām toward them, affirming that such a greeting reaches them.
